verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe running GrowthBook on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose (MongoDB, API, front-end via `docker compose up -d`), plus a self-hostable Proxy. GitHub positions it as open source, and a community user reports running self-hosted GrowthBook happily for months. Missing for 10: a documented non-Docker install path (a user asked for one for shared hosting), and clarity on which paid-tier features are available when self-hosting; the MongoDB dependency was also raised as an operational burden.
